maya (partnerships): Quick sync — NebulaCompute sent projected supply/pricing for H2 2026. Need granular inputs for our cost model (reserved price, spot avg availability, eviction rate, lead times). Can folks review? Link to sheet: https://redwoodco/slack-files/nebula-h2-supply.xlsx
liam (finance): Sharing a small ask — can they split by SKU (A100-40g, A100-80g, H100) and by commitment term (12/24/36)? We use different amort schedules.
andre (infra-ops): They did. See the vendor table they attached. Quick highlights from their email: reserved discounts: 45% @12m, 55% @24m, 62% @36m vs on-demand; spot pool = ~18-30% of steady-state capacity depending on region; average eviction time < 2h for ephemeral jobs.
sophia (sre): Important: they flagged a 'soft' SLA on spot replenishment (no hard SLA) which could increase tail latency for batch-backed endpoints. We should model 1.2x latency penalty for jobs that fall back to reserved.
maya (partnerships): Copy. Andre — can you paste the CSV snippet here so liam can run the amortization quickly?
andre (infra-ops): Sure — pasted below
```
sku,term_months,reserved_price_per_gpu_month,on_demand_price_per_gpu_month,expected_spot_fraction,spot_eviction_rate
A100-40g,12,3200,5800,0.25,0.22
A100-40g,24,2600,5800,0.22,0.18
A100-80g,12,4000,7000,0.20,0.25
H100,36,4500,8200,0.18,0.15
```
liam (finance): Great, thanks. I'll run against current job mix. Two quick clarifications for modeling: 1) do their reserved rates include power/infra pass-through? 2) what's the headroom for burst into spot beyond the pool (i.e., can we burst to 40% if needed)?
partners-bot: NebulaCompute reply logged — answers uploaded to sheet: https://redwoodco/slack-files/nebula-h2-supply-replies.xlsx
maya (partnerships): From vendor reply: reserved = fully loaded rate (power+infra included). Burst headroom: they said 'subject to availability' but can offer temporary burst windows on request for up to +10% of steady state for 90-day periods.
sophia (sre): Noted. For cost/latency simulation, we should model a fallback policy: 1) try spot, 2) if eviction, route to reserved pool (cost * reserved rate + short-term latency hit), 3) if reserved saturated, route to fallback model (smaller model) — estimate 40% quality delta. We'll include those flags in the eval later.
liam (finance): I'll prepare two scenarios: conservative (spot avail = 15%, no burst) and optimistic (spot = vendor avg, +10% burst avail for 90 days). Send the scenario spreadsheet by EOD.
maya (partnerships): Thanks team. Action items: liam — scenario outputs by EOD; andre — add region breakout (us-west/us-east/eu) to the sheet; sophia — define latency/quality penalties for fallback. I'll follow up with Nebula for a written addendum on burst windows and any blackout dates. :thumbsup:
liam (finance): on it.
andre (infra-ops): will update the sheet in 30m.
partners-bot: Reminder: Quarterly vendor sync scheduled 2026-04-02 10:00 PT — added NebulaCompute to agenda.
maya (partnerships): perfect, closing — will post consolidated numbers here once liam shares.
